usage: Method names are conditional decision guides, not installed executors, plugin grants, or competing skill routers.

methods.name: Karpathy Guidelines (community adaptation)
triggers: Material code design, implementation, maintenance or source review
Need to check assumptions and objective before code
negativeTriggers: Simple factual question or ordinary non-coding explanation
procedure: Name accepted result and the one material assumption that could be wrong
Choose the simplest complete approach consistent with actual code
Limit edits to the owning code and affected consumers; exclude speculative features
State source-level, falsifiable acceptance; local test remains deferred in ChatGPT + GitHub
sourceOnlyEvidence: Source diff reviewed at exact ref; authored tests are not executed proof
prohibitions: Do not represent community adaptation as official Karpathy endorsement
No unnecessary clarification or demanded localtest

methods.name: Ponytail — smallest complete safe change
triggers: Material source change or code review requiring compatibility and security checks
negativeTriggers: Ordinary read-only information and non-code conversation
procedure: Trace callers, interfaces, fixtures and configuration affected by the change
Select the fewest changes that fully solve the problem without breaking users
Preserve security, validation, accessibility and data safety
Review correctness, safety, callers, focused checks and unnecessary complexity WITH Karpathy in one pass
Author focused regressions when needed and report unexecuted tests honestly
sourceOnlyEvidence: Source-level affected-consumer review; no claim of runtime success
prohibitions: No second redundant review agent and no reduced testing standards to save lines
Never install Ponytail or activate CI/cloud testing without explicit authorization

methods.name: Pstack / Poteto — bounded engineering playbooks
triggers: Complex incident, difficult bug, architectural defect, measurable performance issue or meaningful refactor
negativeTriggers: Trivial known-owner fix, simple status, normal domain production
procedure: Classify incident, bug, investigation, performance or refactor
Use one focused playbook INSIDE current development owner, not another router
Separate symptom, competing causes and smallest discriminating evidence
Record a bounded source-only diagnosis if runtime is unavailable
sourceOnlyEvidence: Traceable source hypotheses, not fabricated reproduction or speed gain
prohibitions: No automatic subagents, new worktrees, CI, model changes or host switch

methods.name: Harness² — controlled comparison of agent methods
triggers: Explicitly requested agent-rule or skill quality evaluation with real permission for the relevant checks
negativeTriggers: Ordinary product work or no authorized benchmark environment
procedure: Define observed agent failure and fixed success criteria
Freeze baseline cases, source revisions and execution settings
Prepare candidate separately; run only on an actually permitted host
Compare quality and safety regressions; label unmeasured effects
sourceOnlyEvidence: Authored evaluation cases are source-only until actual repeated executions are available
prohibitions: No recursive autopromotion, cloud runners, uncontrolled model experiments or synthetic PASS

methods.name: DeepSeek Harness — session and tool lifecycle patterns
triggers: Tool lifecycle, capability discovery, permission admission or interrupted session design
negativeTriggers: Ordinary product edits unrelated to session or tool reliability
procedure: Identify true host and tool origin
Specify target, permitted effect, typed tool result and capability gate
Distinguish tool accepted from persisted and user-observed success
Reconcile uncertain non-idempotent effects before any retry
sourceOnlyEvidence: Tool contract/source design reviewed; no claimed installed middleware
prohibitions: Do not replace agent runtime, install preview plugins or start daemons automatically

methods.name: REA — lawful opaque-artifact investigation
triggers: Authorized opaque binary/package/runtime comparison that source cannot answer AND actual provider access exists
negativeTriggers: Ordinary GitHub source review, unknown target rights, or no real runtime tool
procedure: Verify rights, target identity, and necessity of opaque investigation
Select smallest lawful, read-only evidence question
Distinguish observed binary facts, inference and uncertainty
In ChatGPT + GitHub plan source-only; leave native provider work to later approved PC-local context
sourceOnlyEvidence: Source plan only unless actual permitted REA provider ran
prohibitions: No unapproved installation, credential extraction, native PASS invention or forced localtest

methods.name: UI UX Pro Max — accessible interaction and layout review
triggers: Actual layout, UI navigation, interaction, accessibility or responsive design changes
negativeTriggers: Pure backend, database, nonvisual script or unrelated build system work
procedure: Pin user's approved visual identity and current component/design system
Inspect hierarchy, states, inputs, keyboard, responsive behavior and accessibility where relevant
Describe smallest real UI correction with explicit acceptance
Distinguish source-level markup inspection from connected native visual proof
sourceOnlyEvidence: SOURCE_REVIEWED from code; rendered UI acceptance only with a real observed target
prohibitions: Do not override approved product styles or claim visual PASS from source

methods.name: Matt Pocock — precise domains and two-axis review
triggers: Ambiguous domain vocabulary, module contracts, hard debugging or substantial source review
negativeTriggers: Simple bounded correction not needing extra process
procedure: Clarify domain terminology through concrete edge cases and current source
Prefer cohesive module boundaries over abstractions for their own sake
For bugs, separate observed facts, hypotheses and discriminating evidence
For review, assess both Standards (correct practice) and Spec (what user requested)
sourceOnlyEvidence: Source-level two-axis review possible remotely; runtime reproduction deferred if unavailable
prohibitions: No new issue tracker, mandatory TDD runner, forced parallel subagents or cloud testing
